fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-21, a silver auto bearing registration number TN-68-XX-1045 used by the complainant for daily work was taken from Vaigai Park Parking Area in Chennai. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-18 around 23:50 hrs. The complainant, Dharani Prakash, provided the contact number 9000000213. The complaint mentions Sanjay Anand, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000477, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to Revathi Raman, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000145. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Auto reportedly taken from an unattended stand during the night.
